# apx scripting API (generated)

Scripts are plain JavaScript run by Apilix after (tests) or before (pre-request) a request. The global `apx` is the only API; `pm` is an alias of it.
Use only the members listed here. Anything else does not exist and makes the script fail.

## Functions

- `apx.test(name, fn)`
- `apx.test.skip(name)`
- `apx.expect(value)`
- `apx.softExpect(value)`
- `apx.assertAll(label)`

## Assertions: apx.expect(value) and apx.softExpect(value)

Chainable words (no effect): `to`, `be`, `been`, `is`, `that`, `which`, `and`, `has`, `have`, `with`, `at`, `of`, `same`, `does`, `still`, `also`.
Negation: `not`.
Assertion properties (no call): `ok`, `true`, `false`, `null`, `undefined`, `NaN`, `exist`, `empty`, `positive`, `negative`, `integer`, `finite`.
Assertion methods:

- `.equal(expected)`
- `.equals(expected)`
- `.eq(expected)`
- `.eql(expected)`
- `.eqls(expected)`
- `.include(expected)`
- `.includes(expected)`
- `.contain(expected)`
- `.contains(expected)`
- `.above(n2)`
- `.gt(n2)`
- `.greaterThan(n2)`
- `.below(n2)`
- `.lt(n2)`
- `.lessThan(n2)`
- `.least(n2)`
- `.gte(n2)`
- `.most(n2)`
- `.lte(n2)`
- `.within(lo, hi)`
- `.closeTo(expected, delta)`
- `.lengthOf(len)`
- `.property(name, val)`
- `.a(type)`
- `.an(type)`
- `.instanceOf(ctor)`
- `.match(regex)`
- `.keys(keysArr)`
- `.key(k)`
- `.string(expected)`
- `.startWith(str)`
- `.endWith(str)`
- `.members(arr)`
- `.includeMembers(arr)`
- `.oneOf(arr)`
- `.everyItem(fn)`
- `.someItem(fn)`
- `.subset(expected)`
- `.deepProperty(path, val)`
- `.satisfy(fn)`
- `.satisfies(fn)`
- `.matchSchema(schema)`

After `deep` (for example `.to.deep.equal(x)`): `equal`.

Example: `apx.test("status is 200", () => { apx.expect(apx.response.code).to.equal(200); });`
